title: CertGate: finite-sample certified selective prediction for multi-site clinical risk models, with label-shift robustness and explainable abstention

creators.name: Zhang, Tony
creators.affiliation: Department of Physiology and Pharmacology, Western University, London, Ontario, Canada

description:
Code and aggregate artifacts for CertGate, a selective-prediction gate for multi-site clinical risk models: it answers when confident and defers the rest. Treating the hospital as the unit of independence, it certifies that the influence-capped answered error rate, averaged over hospitals, stays within a stated budget at a stated confidence (finite-sample in the exchangeable mode). A label-shift mode folds the uncertainty of its correction into the guarantee, and a linear head explains every answer and every abstention exactly.

The archive contains the library, the test suite, the synthetic experiment grid and its frozen outputs, and the aggregate results of a certified run on eICU-CRD v2.0 (20 by-site re-splits). No patient-level data is included; eICU-CRD requires credentialed access through PhysioNet.
